Municipal dimensions, the university synthesis of the measured architectural survey, independently photographed surviving stonework and current 2026 TRT images constrain the 15.80 m drum, Ionic entry, twelve fasces reliefs, northwest blocked door, cornices, corbels, central rooftop pedestal and surviving asymmetric parapet. The entry reliefs are original polygonal interpretations. Interior chambers, lost ancient upper works and the surrounding modern visitor plaza are outside this current exterior asset.
